verdicts.reason: A is broken. The title 'Beauty Studio' spills over the bottom border of the arch frame. The decorative rule lines are cut off from the title and float near the bottom of the canvas. The floral image is chopped into a hard-edged rectangular strip with a gap above the frame, and the bottom third of the canvas is dead space. B keeps the title, both rose ornaments and the rule lines together inside the frame, with good contrast. But the hydrangea cluster is broken into scattered, clipped fragments (a flat crop line at the top of the frame, stray pieces at the left), the frame is pushed down with an empty band above it, and the dot pattern only shows at the edges.
